summary: Holographic Radiance Cascades Global Illumination (HRCGI) for 2D shapes.
summaryText: Holographic Radiance Cascades Global Illumination (HRCGI) for 2D shapes.
remarks: Pair with [`Geometry`](<xref:Geometry>). Emissive shapes contribute light; material transmission controls blockers and colored glass. This is one lighting technique, alongside [`RasterRenderer`](<xref:RasterRenderer>) and [`PTGI`](<xref:PTGI>). The HRC quality presets control probe spacing, independently of [`UDRQuality`](<xref:UDRQuality>) resolution presets. Pass the linear-light output to color management before display.
